name: HERE Optical Film v1
role: Cinematic optical treatment for the existing photography, video, album art and 360 media without changing their layout

reskinRules.do: Layer over existing media only where it adds physical lens/projection depth.
reskinRules.doNot: Do not crop, recolor, replace, obscure or recompose the original media to show off the effect.
reskinRules.motion: Reflections, flare, edge refraction and parallax may react to scroll/viewing angle. Media content itself stays stable unless its existing behavior already moves.
reskinRules.performance: Disable dispersion/refraction first on low-power devices; preserve media playback and scrolling performance.
